# mybcat.com — My Business Care Team (MyBCAT)

## What this site is
My Business Care Team (MyBCAT) provides managed patient access and front desk operations for healthcare practices and multi-location groups.

## Canonical URL rules
- Primary domain: https://mybcat.com
- Trailing slashes are canonical (e.g., /about/ not /about)
